rows.label: Angels of the Zariman
rows.note: Chrysalith access for Yonta's Plasm shop

groups.mode: Steel Path once your gear can handle it
conditions: Sarofang pieces never drop on Rotation C; stay to 20 minutes only if you're also farming Voruna.
Only buy a piece once buying it still leaves 50 Plasm for the build.
Dropped Plasm despawns after 60 seconds, and spectral Thrax must be finished with the Operator's Void Beam.
Drop Chance Boosters and Blessings and loot abilities like Desecrate do nothing for Plasm; Resource Boosters, Smeeta Kavat and Retriever only boost the Thrax drops.
bonuses: After each rotation Thrax spawn (2, plus 1 per extra squad member), each 30% for 1 more Plasm; regroup every 5 minutes so they spawn together.
Run it when Circulus has an Omnia Fissure: a full squad means more Thrax, Reactant adds a 1.25x resource boost, and you crack relics at the same time.

disclosures.title: why Circulus
disclosures.body: Normal Circulus pays as much Plasm per rotation as Steel Path Yuvarium and has higher drop rates. Yuvarium (level 25-30) gives 3 Plasm a rotation and 7.52% for the blueprint, 6% per part. Worst case with zero drops is 250 Plasm, roughly 35-40 Steel Path Circulus rotations; every piece that drops cuts 50-100 off that.

disclosures.title: loadout
disclosures.body: Bring crowd clear (Torid, Boar and a well-modded Amprex were named). A Necramech Summon on the Gear wheel helps clear Thrax. Thrax drain life support 50% faster while alive, and can get stuck spectral until you leave the mission.

conditions: Lua Thrax Plasm is not Zariman Thrax Plasm; Zariman missions don't give it.
